# Kashaf Lasani Cargo Services (KLC)

> KLC is a cargo and transport company in Pakistan. Main route: Sialkot to Karachi. Customers can track a bilty online, book a bilty, and see port status and bilty rates.

## Services
- Bilty tracking: enter a bilty number to see status, route and destination contact.
- Bilty booking: cartons, bales and part loads, charged per kg (or by CBM volume), paid or to-pay.
- Port delivery: export cargo to KPT, QFS, Port Qasim and dry ports.
- Online ledger for business clients.

## Cities served
Sialkot, Karachi, Lahore, Gujranwala, Multan, Rawalpindi, Hyderabad, Sahiwal, Port Qasim.
